question.text: Per SEBI Circular dated September 10, 2025, effective which financial year onwards are Angel Funds with total investments at cost exceeding ₹100 crore REQUIRED to mandatorily carry out an annual audit of compliance with terms of PPM?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the September 10, 2025 SEBI circular noted in the workbook (page 190), Angel Funds with total investments at cost exceeding ₹100 crore are required to mandatorily carry out an annual audit of compliance with terms of PPM from FY 2025-26 onwards. Smaller Angel Funds remain exempt. The Trap: The earlier FY dates pre-date the circular. FY 2026-27 is too late — it would imply the September 2025 circular skipped a year of compliance. Note: Use the workbook's stated effective year (FY 2025-26) and ₹100-crore threshold; no additional planning prescription is added.
